about: Every distinct LoanStatus value in the SBA 7(a) and 504 FOIA files, classified. scripts/markets_build.py fails on any value not listed here, and writes the measured counts per program, file and status (with the FirstDisbursementDate, ChargeOffDate and GrossChargeOffAmount evidence behind each category) to data/markets/foia-status-counts.json. Definitions are quoted from SBA's 7(a) and 504 FOIA data dictionary (7a_504_foia_data_dictionary.xlsx, as of 30 June 2026).

P I F.note: The files write the code with spaces ('P I F'); the dictionary writes 'PIF'. Both are listed.

PIF.note: Dictionary spelling; not present in the 2026-06-30 7(a) files.

EXEMPT.dictionary: EXEMPT = The status of loans that have been disbursed but have not been cancelled, paid in full, or charged off are exempt from disclosure under FOIA Exemption 4
EXEMPT = The status of loans that have been disbursed but have not been cancelled, paid in full, or charged off are exempt from disclosure under FOIA Exemption 4

NOT FUNDED.note: No NOT FUNDED row carries a FirstDisbursementDate (see foia-status-counts.json).

CLOSED.dictionary: CLOSED = Loan that was closed for any reason other than Cancelled, Paid In Full, or Charged Off. This status is no longer in use.
CLOSED.note: Classified as disbursed because the as-of-2026-06-30 file carries a FirstDisbursementDate on almost every CLOSED row (see foia-status-counts.json).

charge_off_split_check: The charter warns that SBA split the charged-off status into more than one code in a 2026 release. The as-of-2026-06-30 files carry exactly one charged-off code, CHGOFF, in both programs, and no other status value has a ChargeOffDate or a positive GrossChargeOffAmount. The build re-checks this on every run: a row with a ChargeOffDate or a positive GrossChargeOffAmount under a status whose category is not charged_off fails the build.
